title: A parsed fabric:// deep link (DEC-0040, DEC-0189)
description: What a fabric:// link asks Fabric to open, after parsing: a conversation with Fabric scoped to a service, a project or both (fabric://chat), a new coding-agent session in a project (fabric://session/new), an existing Fabric or runner session's view (fabric://session/open), or the view that moves a runner's session into Fabric's console, which the person confirms there (fabric://session/continue). It names ids only and never a credential, a prompt or an instruction; `from` names the app the link came from, as the page claims it.

runner.description: A runner kind from the runner catalogue.

session.description: A Fabric session's id or a runner session's id.

projectRef.description: A project id or slug: no slash, no space.

sessionId.description: A session's UUID in lower case (RFC 9562 §4); the parser lowers the link's value (DEC-0189 SL-2).

from.description: The app the link came from, an agent id (DEC-0189 SL-1). The page claims it: Fabric records it and grants nothing on it.
